card.name: Start of brand drug names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a brand drug name split into parts, such as Multi in MultiHance, MULT in MULTAQ, and STR in STRIBILD. It appears after words like of, with, discontinue or dosage.

modes.label: Brand name opening
modes.description: First piece of a capitalized brand name right after a verb or preposition about use of the drug.
modes.example: Extravasation of<< Multi>>Hance may lead to injection site reactions

modes.label: Heading then brand
modes.description: Brand name starting right after a section heading such as Recommended Dosage.
modes.example: 2.2 Recommended Dosage<< STR>>IBILD is a four-drug fixed

modes.label: Other mid-name pieces
modes.description: Weaker hits inside a generic drug name or on a name or separator in a citation.
modes.example: The recommended dose of exem<<est>>ane tablets in early and advanced breast cancer
